title: Platform Specialist
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Apple Ads - Platform Specialist with a real passion for customer excellence to join our Search Ads team to help businesses with promotion and discovery across Apple Services. Operating as both a strategic account manager and a consultative seller across the pre- and post- sale lifecycle. Highly adaptable, self-directed, you are an autonomous problem solver who can independently troubleshoot complex campaign performance issues, architect bold growth strategies and constructively challenge clients to rethink their potential. Effectively partners with performance advertisers in the mobile and app developer ecosystem, you have very strong communication and interpersonal skills, you are highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, team-oriented, and can work independently to meet revenue and business objectives. You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in the mobile and app developer space with performance-type advertisers and agencies.  
  
**Description**  
Manage relationships with clients and agencies in the performance marketing space  
Maintain a high level of outreach via email, phone and meetings to ensure a strong business pipeline  
Develop a strategy for long-term success across your portfolio of clients & prospects  
Act as a thought leader with both clients and agencies  
Work closely with your Manager & Platform Specialist team to ensure accurate execution and alignment with customer objectives  
Use internal & external data sets to understand how to best help grow your customer's business  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Over 5 years in performance account management or sales, with a proven history of expanding existing client portfolios in search and mobile advertising.  
Comprehensive knowledge of the mobile app ecosystem, with specialized background and strong preference for experience within the mobile gaming landscape.  
Rigorous data fluency, with expert command of Excel/Numbers to dissect performance data and build compelling commercial narratives.  
Challenger mindset, skilled at guiding advertisers beyond their comfort zone using proactive, insight-led recommendations.  
Proven agency collaboration, comfortable navigating complex agency hierarchies and direct-advertiser relationships.  
Platform mastery, experienced in self-serve ad operations, campaign optimization, client training, and troubleshooting.  
India market expertise, well-versed in local digital dynamics as well as cross-border import/export business models.  
Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills, capable of delivering high-impact business reviews and articulating complex concepts clearly to senior stakeholders.  
High operational rigor, with meticulous attention to detail, proactive prioritization, and the resilience to execute under tight timelines.  
Completion of the official Apple Ads Certification, with a strong foundational understanding of the Apple Ads product suite, campaign structures, and best practices, is strongly preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree in a related field or equivalent, MBA a plus  
Experience in performance media sales with at least 4 years experience using a self-serve type platform  
Managed India-based clients with domestic and export business in your previous roles  
Experienced in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.  
Excellent communication and presentations skills - both in person and virtually

title: Lead, Merchant Solutions Engineering
description:
**Company Description**

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 **Job Description**

The Lead of the Solutions Engineering (Merchant/Partner Integrations) team will establish a new and steer existing team of engineers who are responsible for the success of developers integrating with PhonePe products.

At PhonePe we consider the developer experience to be central to the overall experience of our merchants. When we do our job well, merchants are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on PhonePe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex payment systems.

PhonePe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Solutions Engineering team is the glue that supports our developers and champions developer experience as part of the overall merchant experience.

Responsibilities:

* Define and deliver a comprehensive technical experience for developers integrating PhonePe
* Develop both the long-term vision and strategy for the Solutions Engineering team and manage day-to-day operations
* Work cross-functionally across PhonePe to develop solutions to meet merchant’s requirements
* Recruit, coach, and develop user facing engineers
* Inspire, motivate and enable individual development and promote career growth of the team
* Develop relationships across the entire organization at PhonePe to influence others in aiming for the best developer experience possible
* Define, implement, and monitor key metrics that ensure the future sustainability and quality of the developer experiences
* Define, document, and implement processes for integration to ensure compliance and standardization across stakeholders
* Improve API integrations by studying current market practices
* Responsible for on-time delivery and overall quality of deliverables
* Working closely with product managers on common goals to achieve best in the class developer and merchant experience for our merchants.

 **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of Techno functional experience with cross functional collaboration with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience in leading, managing and developing user-facing engineering teams
* Background in software development in one or more programming languages, preferably PHP/Java/. Net
* Direct experience as a user-facing engineer is highly desired
* Track record in successfully delivering complex, cross functional technology solutions
* You encourage a healthy work environment that’s both supportive and challenging
* You’re excited to help engineers develop new skills and advance in their careers
* You lead by example, by setting the right context, and by helping teammates do their best work
* You know when to let a team work through problems and when to jump in to help
* You’re technical enough to ask engineers good questions about design and integration decisions
* You have Strong quantitative, analytical, and Problem Solving skills
* Experience in API driven products is a big plus.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal and listening skills
* Comfortable working in a fast paced environment

 **Additional Information**

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)

Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or reasonable accommodation, during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please fill out this form.

Read more about PhonePe on our blog.

Life at PhonePe

Life@MoEngage

Scale @MoEngage

title: Senior Software Engineer 2 - (iOS, Swift)
description:
You will build and ship production iOS apps for a large Indian banking client, where security, performance and release discipline matter more than in a typical consumer app. You will own features end-to-end in Swift — UI, data flow, networking, persistence and App Store release — and be a core part of GeekyAnts' native iOS practice. This is a native-first role, but we are building a mobile team that can flex. Over time you may work on React Native or Flutter projects alongside Swift, with support from our existing teams in both. Candidates who want to stay purely in one stack forever will not be the right fit.

**What you will do:**

* Design, build and maintain iOS features in Swift using UIKit and SwiftUI, following MVVM and clean architecture principles
* Implement secure networking (URLSession, SSL pinning, Codable) and data persistence (Core Data, Realm, SwiftData, UserDefaults) for a banking-grade app
* Write concurrent, responsive code using GCD, OperationQueue, async/await and Combine
* Own quality: unit tests with XCTest, profiling with Instruments, crash triage and fixes
* Handle code signing, provisioning, App Store Connect submissions and release management
* Review code, mentor SE1–SE3 engineers and raise the bar on iOS standards across the team
* Work with the client's product, backend and security teams; translate requirements into technical designs and estimates
* Contribute to presales solutioning (architecture inputs, effort estimates) when needed
* Be open to picking up React Native or Flutter work when project demand shifts

**Must-have skills:**

* 4+ years of hands-on iOS development with at least 2 apps shipped to the App Store.
* Swift & Xcode- Strong Swift (protocols, generics, optionals, value vs reference types), Xcode project structure, UIViewController lifecycle, working knowledge of Objective-C for legacy code
* UI — UIKit- Storyboards, Auto Layout, UITableView, UICollectionView, custom views, navigation and modal flows
* UI — SwiftUI- Views, modifiers, stacks, NavigationStack, TabView, List, Form, sheets and modals; can mix SwiftUI with UIKit
* Concurrency- GCD, OperationQueue, async/await, Task, structured concurrency, thread-safety and main-thread discipline
* State & architecture- @State, @Binding, @ObservedObject, @EnvironmentObject, MVVM, dependency injection (Needle, Swinject or similar)
* Reactive & networking- Combine (publishers, operators, cancellables), URLSession, Codable, SSL/certificate pinning, API error handling
* Persistence- UserDefaults, Core Data; exposure to Realm and SwiftData
* Quality & debugging- Xcode debugger, Instruments (Time Profiler, Leaks, Allocations), crash log symbolication, XCTest unit and UI tests
* Release- Code signing, provisioning profiles, App Store Connect, TestFlight, phased releases

**Good to have:**

* Working exposure to React Native or Flutter, or a demonstrated willingness to learn one
* BFSI / fintech experience: PCI-DSS or RBI-aware development, Keychain, jailbreak and tamper detection, secure storage, biometric auth
* CI/CD for iOS (Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
* Modular architecture (Swift Package Manager, feature modules), Clean Architecture or VIPER
* Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type) and localisation
* Experience working in a client-facing or consulting setup

**Who you are:**

* You care about how the app behaves on a slow network and an old iPhone, not just on the simulator
* You can explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical client stakeholder without hiding behind jargon
* You are comfortable owning a feature from estimate to App Store release, not only the coding part
* You are curious about the wider mobile ecosystem and willing to work across stacks when the business needs it
* You give and take code review feedback well and help junior engineers grow

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT is preferred.
* Candidates with a relevant MCA or equivalent qualification may also be considered.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Head of Growth, Brand & Product Marketing - Mobile Dating App
description:
**About Us**

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

**Job Description**

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Shape the product:** Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
* **Improve the user experience:** Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
* **Build the brand:** Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
* **Own go-to-market:** Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
* **Create marketing content:** Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
* **Build content pipelines:** Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
* **Develop influencer marketing:** Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
* **Establish partnerships:** Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
* **Drive measurable growth:** Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
* **Automate operations:** Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
* **Support future team growth:** As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
* Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
* Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
* Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
* Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
* The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
* Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
* Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
* A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
* The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
* A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
* Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
* Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

  

* Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
* Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
* Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
* Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
* Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
* Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
* Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
* Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

**What We Offer**

  

* A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
* Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
* The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
* The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

* Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
* Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
* Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
* AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
* Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

title: Software Engineer III - Mobile (Android/iOS) Developer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Asset and Wealth Management Technology team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You will be a core technical contributor across multiple business functions, with native Android/IOS skills.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Design, build, and troubleshoot native mobile solutions beyond routine approaches.
* Deliver end-to-end features for Android apps and supporting services, contribute to iOS features and maintenance as needed.
* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Apply strong engineering practices (domain modeling, clean structure, testability, evolution).
* Write secure, high-quality production code; review and debug others' code and build and maintain robust Android architecture (e.g., Clean Architecture, MVVM/MVI) focused on performance and reliability.
* Build reusable UI components/design systems; modernize legacy code where needed and integrate with back-end systems via RESTful APIs/JSON, partner with platform/API teams on scalability and security.
* Improve operational stability by eliminating recurring issues and automating remediation.
* Own production health: investigate crashes/ANRs/perf/auth issues and prevent recurrence and keep platforms current (OS/dependency upgrades, security patches) and support safe, low-downtime releases.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Software development experience (design, build, test, and production support), including significant native Android work.
* Experience in Kotlin, Android SDK, Gradle (including multi-module), Coroutines/Flow, Jetpack (e.g., ViewModel/Lifecycle/Navigation/Paging), Compose (Material 3) and XML Views, DI/networking (e.g., Hilt, Retrofit/OkHttp), performance and crash/ANR analysis.
* Working knowledge of Swift, Xcode, SwiftUI/UIKit; ability to deliver fixes/features and participate in code reviews while keeping cross-platform behavior consistent.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Experience with distributed systems and mobile networking patterns (REST/JSON).
* Strong understanding of mobile data persistence/caching/offline patterns; familiarity with SQL/NoSQL through service layers.
* Strong fundamentals in mobile security, secure storage (Keystore/Keychain), encryption in transit, certificate pinning, biometrics/modern auth, minimizing sensitive-data exposure.
* Experience in logging, monitoring, analytics, crash reporting, performance analysis with observability/production readiness
* Experience in CI/CD and automated testing (e.g., JUnit/Espresso/Compose UI; XCTest) with Agile/Scrum experience and strong SDLC discipline.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Regulated-domain experience (banking/financial services) and security-sensitive mobile products.
* Stronger iOS depth (Combine, Swift Concurrency, SPM, Instruments).
* Passkeys/FIDO, mobile app hardening/runtime protection.
* Modern release practices (feature flags, staged rollouts; Play Store/App Store processes).
* End-to-end mobile test automation, push notifications, and familiarity with code quality/security scanning tools.
* Cloud/observability exposure (e.g., AWS); AWS certification a plus.

**ABOUT US**

title: WhatsApp - Software Engineer - iOS
description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done — people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go — staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation.As an iOS engineer at WhatsApp you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set direction for a team's technical area, lead major initiatives end to end, and be one of the people the pillar relies on to make the right engineering trade-offs under real ambiguity.  
  
  

### **WhatsApp - Software Engineer - iOS Responsibilities:**

* Build and ship client features for WhatsApp on iOS, with a focus on performance, reliability and responsiveness.
* Own iOS client architecture for services surfaces — payments, commerce and the everyday money-centric flows people already come to WhatsApp for.
* Work across Swift and Objective-C with the iOS SDK, and partner with server and platform teams on API design.
* Set direction and goals for a team, lead major initiatives and drive them to completion across functions.
* Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications, and make the engineering trade-offs a 0-to-1 effort demands.
* Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt.
* Establish ownership of significant components, features or systems with expert end-to-end understanding.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, help onboard new team members and raise the engineering bar in the team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in product management, design, data science and operations to build innovative application experiences.
* Partner with payments, legal, compliance and local operations partners to ship services that meet the reliability and regulatory bar expected in India.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language, or 4+ years of experience with a PhD
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building complex applications for the iPhone or iPad using Objective-C/C++/Swift with the iOS SDK and other frameworks
* Experience with multithreading programming and mobile memory management
* Experience shipping at a high release cadence with strong attention to craft and detail
* Experience building for the Indian market, including familiarity with UPI and India's digital payments ecosystem
* In-market experience in India, or experience at an India-based consumer technology or fintech company operating at scale

title: Sr. iOS Engineer
description:
We're building the next generation of travel and expense (T&E) technology using AI and large language models. Our mobile platform blends cutting-edge AI with strong product and UX so travelers get an intelligent companion, not just another booking app. The app should understand needs, anticipate requests, and deliver personalized help through conversational UI and rich, immersive interactions.  
  
You'll work at the intersection of AI and mobile, helping define how travelers interact with this kind of product on iOS.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design and ship innovative UX patterns for **conversational interfaces and AI-driven experiences** on iOS

* **5+ years** of professional development experience with strong **Swift** skills, building high quality iOS apps
* Deep understanding of **Swift** and the iOS SDK, including:
* + **Swift concurrency (async/await, Task, actors)**, structured concurrency, and modern GCD usage
  + **SwiftUI** for building production UIs; familiarity with UIKit and interoperability is a plus
  + Experience with **Combine** or other reactive patterns, and when to prefer them vs. async/await
* Strong grasp of **iOS architecture** (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture, modularization) suitable for AI‑powered, stateful, and real‑time features
* Solid understanding of **JSON**, **REST**, WebSockets, streaming APIs and robust networking layers (error handling, retries, offline support)
* Experience with **offline storage**, background processing, threading and **push notifications**

* Familiarity with **LLM‑driven features** (prompt design, integrating LLM APIs, handling latency, fallbacks, guardrails) and/or **conversational UX**

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Mobile App Development
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Patient Care Solutions Mobile Center of Excellence (Mobile CoE) is focused on building secure, scalable and high-quality mobile solutions while establishing reusable capabilities, engineering patterns and development practices that can be adopted across multiple products.  
  
The Senior Software Engineer is a strong hands-on technical contributor responsible for the design, development, testing and delivery of mobile application features and shared mobile capabilities. The role works closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, UX, Security, DevOps and engineering teams to deliver solutions aligned with Mobile CoE architecture and engineering standards.  
  
The individual should have strong mobile engineering fundamentals and demonstrate expertise in mobile architecture, performance, security, observability, automation, CI/CD, AWS cloud-integrated development and AI-assisted software engineering.

**Job Description**
===================

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test and deliver high-quality mobile application features, reusable components and shared capabilities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Tech Leads and UX teams to understand requirements, assess technical feasibility and translate requirements into implementable solutions.
* Participate actively in technical discussions, design reviews and architecture decisions, bringing a strong mobile engineering perspective.
* Apply established Mobile CoE architecture patterns, coding standards and engineering practices, while contributing improvements based on implementation experience.
* Build reusable mobile components, libraries and common capabilities that can be adopted across applications where appropriate.
* Maintain high code quality through clean design, code reviews, unit testing, automated quality checks and secure coding practices.
* Understand the end-to-end application architecture, APIs, AWS services and integrations while developing deep expertise in assigned components.
* Analyze and improve mobile application **performance, reliability, security and user experience** using appropriate profiling, diagnostics and engineering practices.
* Implement appropriate mobile security practices including authentication, authorization, secure storage, session/token management and protection of sensitive data.
* Build appropriate **logging, telemetry, crash reporting and observability** into mobile applications to support troubleshooting and operational monitoring.
* Contribute to automated build, test, CI/CD and release processes and continuously improve engineering efficiency.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues, participate in root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective solutions.
* Adopt an **AI-first engineering mindset**, using AI-assisted tools throughout the SDLC for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test generation, code understanding, technical documentation and developer productivity.
* Identify opportunities to use AI to **automate repetitive engineering activities, accelerate development and improve software quality**, while ensuring appropriate human review and validation.
* Apply responsible AI-assisted development practices, ensuring generated code and recommendations are reviewed for **correctness, security, maintainability and compliance**.
* Share technical knowledge, reusable solutions, AI-enabled engineering practices and implementation learnings across the Mobile CoE.

**Desired Technical Skills / Experience**

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience, preferably **7+ years**, with significant experience in mobile application development.
* Strong experience with one or more modern mobile technologies such as **Flutter, React Native, iOS/Swift or Android/Kotlin**.
* Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, design patterns, state management, navigation, application lifecycle and API integration.
* Experience building **reusable mobile components, SDKs, libraries or shared capabilities** across applications.
* Strong knowledge of mobile application performance optimization including startup, responsiveness, memory/resource utilization and network performance.
* Good understanding of UX principles, accessibility and mobile design systems.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, secure storage, encryption, session/token management and secure mobile development practices.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and **AWS-hosted backend services**.
* Experience with automated testing including unit, integration and mobile UI automation.
* Experience with **mobile build automation and CI/CD pipelines**.
* Experience with logging, telemetry, crash reporting, diagnostics and application performance monitoring.
* Working knowledge of **AWS and cloud-integrated mobile architectures**, with an understanding of reliability, performance, security and cost-conscious engineering.
* Experience with static code analysis, security scanning and vulnerability remediation.
* Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe software development practices.
* Strong practical experience using **AI coding assistants and AI-enabled engineering tools** for coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, documentation and code review support.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions rather than accepting generated code by default, with appropriate attention to **security, quality, maintainability and accuracy**.
* Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve **developer productivity, engineering automation and software quality**.
* Exposure to building or integrating **AI-enabled application capabilities** is an advantage.
* Experience developing healthcare, regulated or security-sensitive applications is preferred.

**Mobile CoE Mindset**

* Think beyond a single application and identify opportunities for **reuse and standardization across mobile products**.
* Prefer common patterns and shared capabilities over application-specific solutions where appropriate.
* Contribute implementation learnings back into **Mobile CoE standards, reference patterns and engineering practices**.
* Help improve developer productivity through **automation, AI-assisted engineering, tooling and common development practices**.
* Collaborate across product teams to encourage consistent approaches to **architecture, security, quality, performance and observability**.
* Experiment with emerging **mobile and AI engineering technologies**, evaluate their practical value and help bring useful practices into the CoE.
* Share reusable approaches and engineering learnings so that improvements made for one product can benefit other mobile teams.

**Preferred Professional Training and Certifications**

* Professional training or certifications related to **iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native or other relevant mobile technologies**.
* AWS cloud fundamentals or developer certification.
* Training or certification related to **AI-assisted software development, application security, DevOps, Agile or software architecture** is an advantage.

**Desired Professional Characteristics**

* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently deliver complex technical assignments.
* Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across Product, Architecture, UX, Security, QA and DevOps teams.
* Proactive in identifying technical problems and proposing practical solutions.
* Willingness to share knowledge and support other engineers through technical discussions and code reviews.
* **Curious and experimental mindset toward AI and emerging engineering technologies, balanced with sound engineering judgment.**
* Continuous learning mindset with interest in advancing mobile, AWS and AI-enabled software engineering practices.

**What's exciting about the role**

**Key Responsibilities**
